authorizationBasis: Existing explicit authorization to create/configure a brand-new clean Firebase PREPROD plus the project's standing rule to diagnose root cause read-only before any retry; this diagnostic performs no project create, IAM write, deploy or provider/data write.
purpose: Determine why the already authorized clean PREPROD project create failed before any deploy, by inspecting target visibility, provisioning identity project-level roles, project parent scope and resourcemanager.projects.create permission when testable.
